newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance rises on price hike news.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance rises on price hike news.

text.p: Shares of petrochemicals giant Reliance Industries Ltd jumped three percent in afternoon trade on Wednesday boosted by news the firm has raised prices of its key product, brokers said.
Trade sources said Reliance has raised polyester filament yarn to 71,000 rupees per tonne from 68,000 rupees.
Reliance is India's largest producer of polyester filament yarn with a capacity of 210,000 tonnes a year. The company was not immediately available for comment.
At 0740 GMT on the Bombay Stock Exchange, the share was up 9.50 rupees, or 2.74 percent, at 356.25 after rallying to 358.
The share rose 12.80 rupees, or 3.78 percent, to 357 at the National exchange.
